ref.quote: Dit zijn kredieten bestemd voor de kosten voor repatriëring en verwijdering van ongewenst geachte personen. (vliegtuigtickets, politie-escortes, medische kosten, organisatie van Special Flights…)
ref.note: Most of the line is staff of the Immigration Office. New closed centres are built through the Buildings Agency (separate line) and escorts are carried out by the federal police (separate line), so places and returns also depend on those budgets. Removals also depend on cooperation from countries of return. confirmed
